# Multimodal Test Fixtures

Synthetic, license-clean fixtures used by `tests/unit/test_extractors_with_fixtures.py`
and any future end-to-end ingestion tests (T4.9+).

## Files

| File              | Generator (in `generate_fixtures.py`) | Approx. size |
| ----------------- | -------------------------------------- | ------------ |
| `sample.pdf`      | `pymupdf` (2-page; "Hello World" + "Page 2 content") | < 5 KB |
| `sample.docx`     | `python-docx` (1 heading + 1 paragraph) | < 10 KB |
| `sample.pptx`     | `python-pptx` (2 slides, blank layout) | < 35 KB |
| `sample.wav`      | stdlib `wave` (5s 440 Hz mono 16-bit @ 16 kHz) | ~ 156 KB |
| `sample.mp4`      | `ffmpeg lavfi testsrc + sine` (5s, 320x240@10fps) | < 200 KB |
| `text-image.png`  | `Pillow` (200x100 white canvas, "Hello World") | < 5 KB |
| `sample.html`     | string write (`<h1>Title</h1><p>Body</p>`) | < 1 KB |

The aggregate size is held below 500 KB to clear the pre-commit
`check-added-large-files` gate (T0.22).

## Regenerating

```
cd backend-new/tests/fixtures/multimodal
uv run python generate_fixtures.py
```

The generator is idempotent: it overwrites existing fixtures. Commit the
regenerated bytes whenever assertions in
`tests/unit/test_extractors_with_fixtures.py` depend on the new content.

## ffmpeg

`sample.mp4` is the only fixture that calls an external binary. If
`ffmpeg` is not on `PATH`, the script prints a warning and skips that
fixture. The matching extractor test gates itself on the presence of
`sample.mp4`, so a missing binary cannot fail the suite.
